{{Top|fa}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:Shuggoth-TM306.png]] |name=Shuggoth |homeworld=[[Mon Cala]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Quarren]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 22: Guns for Hire}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]] |pronouns=She/her{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 22: Guns for Hire}} {{AD|Disney+}} |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Dark]] |skin=Orange |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners=A [[Unidentified Mon Calamari viceroy's son|Mon Calamari prince]] {{C|lover}} |siblings= |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|We knew fate was not on our side.''"
"''Who cares about fate? I love you.''"
"''And I will always love you.|Shuggoth and a Mon Calamari prince|}} Around [[9 ABY]], [[Captain]] '''Shuggoth''' [[Commanding officer|commanded]] a [[Unidentified Quarren freighter|freighter]] crewed by members of the [[Quarren]] [[species]]. She fell in love with a [[Unidentified Mon Calamari viceroy's son|Mon Calamari prince]], and the pair eloped aboard the captain's [[Freighter|starship]]. However, the [[Unidentified Mon Calamari viceroy|viceroy]] who the [[prince]] was the [[Gender|son]] of hired a [[Mandalorian resistance|force]] of [[Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] led by [[Axe Woves]] to find Shuggoth and bring the prince back to his home. When the [[Gideon's light cruiser|light cruiser]] used by Woves' unit [[Capture of a Mon Calamari viceroy's son|approached]] the Quarren freighter, the latter's captain, believing the larger [[starship]] to be under the control of [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]], attempted to open negotiations in order to secure safe passage for her vessel. Woves, however, explained his mission to Shuggoth, and, when a Mandalorian boarding party eventually entered the freighter's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] with the aim of securing the prince, the captain and her lover were forced to say sorrowful goodbyes to each other. ==Biography== ===An encounter in space=== {{Quote|Hail, Imperial friends. We are a peaceful Quarren freighter making our way to do business in the Mid Rim. And were unaware of any local warlords that required payment.''"
"''I am not a criminal.''"
"''Of course not. I intended no disrespect. ''[…]'' I meant to say that we were not aware of the majestic Imperial presence in this sector, and we will gladly hire your protection.|Shuggoth and Axe Woves|}} [[File:QuarrenFreighter-GunsForHire.png|thumb|left|300px|Captain Shuggoth commanded a freighter crewed by Quarrens.]] The [[Quarren]] Shuggoth, who [[Homeworld|hailed]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]] [[Mon Cala]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' was the [[captain]] of a small Quarren-crewed [[Unidentified Quarren freighter|freighter]] around [[9 ABY]].{{MandoDate|22}} At one point, she fell in love with a [[Unidentified Mon Calamari viceroy's son|Mon Calamari prince]], the [[Gender|son]] of a [[Unidentified Mon Calamari viceroy|viceroy]]. The captain eloped with the [[prince]], taking him aboard her [[freighter]] and traveling into deep [[Realspace|space]] in order to avoid detection by both of their families. During the voyage, Shuggoth spent [[time]] in her personal [[Water|saltwater]] tank on the [[starship]]'s [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], where a crewmember [[Diet|fed]] her a [[goldfish]]. To Shuggoth's satisfaction, the ship's [[Unidentified Quarren navigator|navigator]] informed her of their discovery of a way to bypass the [[Hyperspace route|hyperspace trade routes]] leading to the [[moon]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 10: The Passenger}} [[Trask]]. At that point, however, [[Unidentified Quarren crew member|another crewmember]] also notified the captain of an approaching [[Gideon's light cruiser|Class 546 Cruiser]]—appearing to be under the command of [[Imperial Military|Imperial military forces]] but in reality [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by a [[Mandalorian resistance|Mandalorian mercenary force]] led by [[Axe Woves]] and commissioned by the [[Mon Calamari]] [[viceroy]] to find Shuggoth and retrieve her son. Upon learning that the larger [[Class 546 Cruiser|light cruiser]] was too powerful for their freighter to defeat, Shuggoth ordered for communications to be opened with the former [[Light cruiser|vessel's]] commander and had the water drained from the tank she was in. The captain then hailed the [[capital ship]], addressing the imagined Imperial crew of the vessel as "friends" and claiming that her own command was a "peaceful" freighter heading for the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] on a commercial trip. Shuggoth confessed her ignorance of any [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[warlord]]s in the locality to which tributes would have to be paid, to which Woves responded via [[Comm unit|comm]] that he was not a "criminal." The Quarren captain quickly apologized and corrected her remark to instead refer to the larger ship as part of "the majestic Imperial presence" in the [[sector]] they were in. Shuggoth then further went on to suggest that her freighter hire the protection offered by the light [[cruiser]], which Woves countered by explaining that his ship was operated by a force of hired [[Mandalorian]]s. ===Lovers parted=== {{Quote|You see, we've been commissioned to track you down, Captain Shuggoth.|Axe Woves|}} [[File:Shuggoth_and_Mon_Calamari_in_space_Mando_S3.png|thumb|right|320px|Shuggoth was separated from her lover, a Mon Calamari prince.]] As the capital ship made preparations for its crew to [[Capture of a Mon Calamari viceroy's son|board]] the Quarren freighter, the latter's captain protested by proclaiming it an act of war, an accusation that Woves summarily dismissed. The Mandalorian leader let Shuggoth know who his employer was, which prompted the captain to denounce as lies the viceroy's claims that Shuggoth had fled with her son. The freighter's captain launched into a tirade about her supposed lack of interest in catalyzing the historically tense relationship between the Quarren and Mon Calamari, only for Woves to reveal that he was aware of Shuggoth having romantic feelings for the runaway prince. The distraught prince at that point entered the freighter's bridge, joining in the verbal protests against the plan to return him home. In response, Woves issued a warning that he would have Shuggoth's ship damaged if the Mon Calamari did not comply. Urged by the Mandalorian, Shuggoth then attempted to convince her lover to return home. The captain ultimately proclaimed her eternal love for the prince. At that point, a Mandalorian boarding party also marched onto the vessel's bridge, and as the Mon Calamari was taken away, Shuggoth encouraged him and claimed that they would see each other again. After the Mandalorians led the prince through the door out of the bridge, the captain returned to her command chair. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I can't destroy everything I've built for a childish fling.''"
"''Is that all this was to you?''"
"''No, that's not what I meant. But you need to go.|Shuggoth and the Mon Calamari prince|}} [[File:Mon_Calamari_Viceroy_son_MandoS3.png|thumb|left|250px|The Mon Calamari prince Shuggoth fell in love with]] An [[Color|orange]]-skinned and dark-[[eye]]d female Quarren, Shuggoth was a [[diplomat]]ic individual. Upon encountering a [[warship]] that she realized the freighter under her command could not prevail against in [[Space warfare|combat]], the captain initiated communications with the vessel, employing ever more ingratiating forms of address as her assumptions about the other ship were proven wrong. Shuggoth fell deeply in love with a Mon Calamari prince, going so far as to elope with him. She was not above lying and engaging in a misdirecting tirade in order to prevent others from interfering with that relationship. After Shuggoth was confronted with the unavoidable reality of her relationship being ended by the prince being forcibly taken away, she briefly remarked on her unwillingness to let her "childish fling" negatively affect her achievements in life. However, after the prince picked up on that comment, the captain claimed that it did not in fact reflect her true feelings—which she ultimately professed to be of everlasting love. During their last moments together on the bridge of her ship, Shuggoth briefly yet affectionately touched the Mon Calamari's visage with her facial [[Limb|tentacles]]. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|I intended no disrespect. Basic is not my native tongue.|Shuggoth|}} Shuggoth spoke the [[Quarrenese]] [[language]] and was also a non-native speaker of [[Galactic Basic Standard]]. After she, having presumed that the Mandalorian [[mercenary]] Axe Woves was an [[Imperial officer]], referred to him as a warlord—only to be corrected by Woves that he was not a criminal—Shuggoth claimed that the misunderstanding was caused by her lack of perfect mastery of Basic. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Don't make us damage your girlfriend's pretty little ship.|Axe Woves, to the Mon Calamari prince|}} Shuggoth wore a green-colored uniform consisting of a long-sleeved [[Clothing|tunic]] and pants as well as dark brown [[boot]]s. On both shoulders of her tunic the captain also wore a patch with an emblem. On the bridge of Shuggoth's freighter, her command chair was situated above an area of the floor into which a transparent tank could be recessed. The tank could be filled with [[salt]]water in which the captain could spend time immersed. ==Behind the scenes== Shuggoth appeared in "[[Chapter 22: Guns for Hire]]," the sixth episode of the [[Disney+]] television show ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''{{'s}} [[The Mandalorian Season Three|third season]]. The episode aired on [[April 5]], [[2023]].{{InsiderCite|222|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season Three Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season Three Companion}} The character was performed by [[Joanna Bennett]] and voiced by [[Christine Adams]], and [[Aaron McBride]] created a concept illustration of Shuggoth for the episode.{{SW|url=news/mando-download-chapter-22-guns-for-hire|text=Mando Download: "Chapter 22: Guns for Hire"}} ==Appearances== *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 22: Guns for Hire}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=the-mandalorian-s3-stills-gallery|text=Stills Gallery | The Mandalorian Season 3}} {{Po}} {{CardGameSet|set={{SWCT|set=The Mandalorian - Season 3 - Weekly Set - Chapter 22|parent=1}}|cards= *{{SWCT|set=The Mandalorian - Season 3 - Weekly Set - Chapter 22|cardname=01}} {{Po}} *{{SWCT|set=The Mandalorian - Season 3 - Weekly Set - Chapter 22|cardname=01 (Event Exclusive)}} {{Po}} *{{SWCT|set=The Mandalorian - Season 3 - Weekly Set - Chapter 22|cardname=02}} {{Po}} }} *{{SW|url=news/mando-download-chapter-22-guns-for-hire|text=Mando Download: "Chapter 22: Guns for Hire"}} {{Po}} *{{SWCT|set=The Mandalorian - Season 3 - Concept Art|cardname=1 - Chapter 22|link=1 - The Mandalorian - Season 3 - Concept Art - Chapter 22}} {{Po}} *{{DisneyGallery|Disney Gallery: The Mandalorian: The Making of Season 3|The Mandalorian: The Making of Season 3}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Shuggoth}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=シャガス |ka=შაგოთი |nl=Shuggoth }} [[Category:Captains]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Quarren]]
